title: Write a test script in the browser and run it on a real device
description:
No setup, no deploy: write a test script right in the browser. Create a new script, paste the code (here, "go to live TV"), save it, pick a device and run it. The device is driven live in the page, and the report comes back with the screenshots, the video and every step.

Open source and free.
